summary: Improvements to media session and control include richer telemetry for audio-session arbitration and interrupts, tests for suspend/resume across interruptions, holding transiently interrupted audio sessions across the suspension they cause, and ensuring the media-control mute is cleared when an element stops being controlled. These changes sharpen how the browser negotiates audio focus with the OS and report that behavior for diagnostics and tuning — **better audio-focus handling** for more predictable playback when other apps intervene.
